parity.reason: server clamps result_limit to 30 with no pagination (limit=100 requested, result_limit=30, truncated=true); the 30 returned rows are exactly the first 30 rg rows, so the disagreement is truncation, not a mismatch of matching semantics

useful_for_task.precision: 100/100 rows in the rg population begin with a log call (log( or self.log(); zero prose/comment hits)
useful_for_task.hotkey_panel_caption_coverage: the union query reaches the panel open/close/show/hide/state sites and the CAPTION_PAINT emitter at :9497
gaps: self.log_fn(...) calls have no literal 'log(' and are invisible to this pattern - that is exactly how HOTKEY_PRESSED is emitted at :3534
multi-line log(...) calls whose term appears on a continuation line are never matched by any single-line regex
70 of 100 sites cannot be enumerated through this tool at any limit (30-row clamp, no offset)

not_measured.source_revision: codeintel_grep envelope exposes effective_scope/result_limit/pattern_mode/truncated only; no version or commit field, so an MCP source revision is unavailable (UNKNOWN)
not_measured.latency_variance: single sample at 1373 ms; earlier identical-shape calls measured ~98-198 ms, but no repeated sampling was taken, so no latency distribution is claimed

side_effects: none: no source edits, no index refresh/bootstrap, no build, no tests
